headline: Kyrgyzstan is ready to work with Russia on new projects
summary: Kyrgyz First Deputy Prime Minister Daniyar Amangeldiev met Russian Deputy Prime Minister Alexander Novak. The sides discussed cooperation on new projects.
why: Economic cooperation agreements between neighbouring states can affect trade, investment flows and regional infrastructure projects.
original_headline: Кыргызстан готов работать с Россией над новыми проектами
